template_eligibility: raw measured positive initial/final counts and complete original observation window; no target>initial filter
extrapolation: cycle each route's last complete measured tuples in original order
clock: sum of selected passage days, including experimental prefix
final_segment: select with full candidate window, then truncate retained path at day 1000
oxygen: fixed scenario oxygen from the true root; do not replay observed oxygen
passage: native positive observation day nearest target; normalize composition and rescale to next tuple's inoculum
summary: equal-route median and type-7 IQR; protocol spread, not stochastic or biological CI
